items.desc_now: Windows 桌面端专用的 DeepSeek Harness 通知卡：任务跑完、等你审批、等你回答时在屏幕角落弹出。跟随系统主题与 DPI，落在鼠标那块屏幕，文字用 GDI ClearType 绘制，不抢焦点。没有网页端那一半，不提供浏览器通知、页面浮层或标签页标题标记。Windows desktop only, no web build: a native notice card that never takes focus.
items.desc_prev: Focus-free notification cards for DeepSeek Harness on Windows. Turn finished, approval pending, question pending. Follows the system theme, DPI and text size, lands on the monitor under the pointer, and draws text with GDI ClearType.
